row.why: 'My fiancee and I are not ready' needs the plural adjective jaahzeen; he said a singular form (engine: mishtahaz), Amal: 'plural', he said مش جاهزين.
row.english: My fiancee and I are not ready.
row.proposed_rule: An adjective about two or more people takes the plural ending -een: 5atibti u ana mish jaahzeen (not jaahez).

rulings.why: Number agreement of an adjective; A8 covers gender only and A9 covers noun plurals, so no bucket fits - PROPOSE rather than force A8.
